equivalentQuery: WITH BillableOrders AS (SELECT CustomerId, Total FROM dbo.Orders WHERE Status <> N'Cancelled') SELECT CustomerId, COUNT_BIG(*) AS OrderCount, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM BillableOrders GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) >= 20;
negativeQuery: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT_BIG(*) AS OrderCount, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) >= 20;
